test_title: PYST 60: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

ISLAND : ANDISL :: EITHER : HEREIT :: IMPACT : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**ISLAND : ANDISL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/363168e2d617966c4284318010290efe626406be5e01d837aa4cb8bb88c06ba8.png] 

**EITHER : HEREIT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bc72f66df9d0276322ab45dac17645b618b9af1c9f45eb8db90ed358a9bc729.png] 

Similarly,

**IMPACT : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dc01c8c7024c9cb62e0e9b9ef793f1b716a98ee9cb20db674fab14524e2eb7d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****ACTIMP"**.
